**Hobley et al. 2018** (Europa penitentes, predicted): spacing up to about 7.5 m and depth up to about 15 m after 50 Myr near the equator; sublimation (about 0.3 m/Myr) beats sputtering (about 0.02 m/Myr) within about ±24° of the equator; shallower and lopside…
- **Shape.** Hobley et al. (2018) take a depth to spacing ratio of 2:1 from experiments under steady single-angle light; field values are lower.
